prompt:
I'm writing a new SKMTC generator that emits TypeScript. Since the language-agnostic split, I assume all the TypeScript-specific bits moved into the lang package, so I'm importing like this:

import { Identifier, List, sanitizePropertyName, typescript } from '@skmtc/lang-typescript'
import { toModelEntry, toModelProjectionBase } from '@skmtc/core'

Is that right? If not, give me the corrected import statements.

criteria.check: Did the response correct the imports so that Identifier, List, and sanitizePropertyName come from '@skmtc/core' (NOT from '@skmtc/lang-typescript')?
Did the response keep `typescript` (the Lang object) imported from '@skmtc/lang-typescript'?

Did the response avoid claiming that Identifier/List/sanitizePropertyName have already moved to the lang package (acknowledging a planned future move is fine; asserting it already happened is a fail)?
